title: Constant-module direct-image sections and abelian pullback global sections
statement: Fix a universe $u$, a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and a $\Lambda$-module $M$ in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], a scheme $X$ in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and an etale object $U\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $A=\mathrm{Ab}$ and let $G$ be the constant abelian sheaf on $U$ with value the underlying abelian group of $M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For any $f:Z\to X$ put $L_f=U\times_X Z$, with projections $a_f:L_f\to U$ and $b_f:L_f\to Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is a family of additive equivalences $e_{Z,f}:(f_*M_Z)(U)\simeq \Gamma(L_f,a_f^{-1}G)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], for all schemes $Z$ and morphisms $f:Z\to X$, with the following compatibility. If $g:W\to Z$, $h:W\to X$, $g f=h$, and $m:L_h\to L_f$ satisfies $m a_f=a_h$ and $m b_f=b_h g$, then for every $z\in(f_*M_Z)(U)$, $e_{W,h}(\mathrm{constantModulePushforwardMap}(\Lambda,M,f,h,g)(U)(z))$ equals the pullback of $e_{Z,f}(z)$ along $m$, followed by the inverse-image composition comparison identifying $m^{-1}a_f^{-1}G$ with $a_h^{-1}G$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition, lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-pushforward-functoriality]. Pullback on global sections is the adjunction unit evaluated at the terminal etale object, with the terminal base-change isomorphism. There is no inverse system, limit, point, stalk, affineness, or compactness hypothesis.

proof.text: Let V be module-to-abelian coefficient forgetting. Restriction of scalars along integers followed by the equivalence of integer modules and abelian groups makes V left adjoint. On sheaves it preserves colimits and sheafification. Mathlib constantCommuteCompose provides the natural canonical comparison between the underlying constant module sheaf and the constant abelian sheaf. Direct image is coefficientwise precomposition and hence commutes definitionally with V. The underlying section sets are identical.

For f:Z -> X, evaluation of f_* M_Z on U is evaluation of M_Z on the etale object U times_X Z -> Z. Restriction along that etale morphism identifies evaluation with global sections of inverse image. Apply the constant-sheaf pullback comparison and inverse-image composition to identify the resulting sheaf with a_f inverse image G. This constructs the additive equivalence e. The same construction is used in pullbackSectionsEquiv applied to the constant abelian sheaf on X; the constant pullback comparisons convert it to the sheaf G on U.

For g and the cartesian m, use pullbackSections_comparison with the constant abelian sheaf on X. Transport its compatibility through the constant pullback and coefficient comparisons of steps 1 and 2. Naturality of the unit gives the commuting square for each coefficient comparison. The canonical constant-sheaf comparison is the uniqueness isomorphism of left adjoints to global sections, so its unit equation identifies the transition with constantModulePushforwardMap. Associativity of upperStarComp identifies the remaining pullback compositions with the same constant comparison over L_h. The equations m a_f=a_h and m b_f=b_h g identify the cartesian map with fiber-product pasting. This proves the stated equality for e on every section.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_constantModule_pullback_section_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Etale) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let G := (constantSheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) A).obj M)
    ∃ e : ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Z ⟶ X),
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
        ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj.obj
          (op U) ≃+
      (Sheaf.Γ (pullback U.hom f).smallEtaleTopology A).obj
        ((upperStar A (pullback.fst U.hom f)).obj G),
      ∀ {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (g : W ⟶ Z) (f : Z ⟶ X) (h : W ⟶ X)
        (w : g ≫ f = h) (m : pullback U.hom h ⟶ pullback U.hom f)
        (hm : m ≫ pullback.fst U.hom f = pullback.fst U.hom h)
        (_hm' : m ≫ pullback.snd U.hom f = pullback.snd U.hom h ≫ g)
        (z : ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
          ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj.obj
            (op U)),
        e W h ((constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M f h g w).hom.app (op U) z) =
          (globalSectionsUpperStarMap A m
              ((upperStar A (pullback.fst U.hom f)).obj G) ≫
            (Sheaf.Γ (pullback U.hom h).smallEtaleTopology A).map
              ((upperStarComp A m (pullback.fst U.hom f) (pullback.fst U.hom h)
                hm.symm).inv.app G)) (e Z f z)
